goal: 把 factor_digging 的自动实验框架推进为 verifier-grounded auto-research 框架：显式研究议程 + 可追溯假设 + 自动实验 + 独立 reviewer/claim ledger + knowledge graph/typed retrieval + 成本感知调度。

deliverables: RSI 项目 H1–H5 结论回填为 claims
acceptance: >=8 claims 且全部有 review decision
evidence 路径与 sha256 可校验

deliverables: hypothesis generator（经济逻辑+知识约束）
experiment designer（面板/算子/预算/对照）
acceptance: 每条新 claim 有 evidence + reviewer decision

deliverables: reviewer 批准式 harness 自改进
acceptance: 调度策略 vs 固定轮询有可报告差异（含置信区间/多 seed）

boundaries.score_window_feedback: forbidden in loop; every experiment records whether score window was read
boundaries.data_boundary: 只用本地 Data/ 与 data_processed/ 已有面板；原始数据只读
boundaries.score_window_usage: only final verification, never inside loop
